s.note: Slow-braised beef pies with a puff pastry lid, tomato sauce on the side
s.how: Braise 800g diced beef chuck in stock and Worcestershire for 2.5 hours until tender, then thicken and cool. Line pie tins with shortcrust, fill with the beef and top with a puff pastry lid. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Damper bread baked or wrapped on sticks over coals, with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour until crumbly. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until it just comes together. Shape into a round, score the top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes, or wrap around green sticks over coals. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

m.n: Mick's camp sausage and onion sandwiches
m.note: Beef sausages and fried onions in white bread, while Mick makes a show of fixing the car
m.how: Cook 8 thick beef sausages slowly over low coals or a barbecue, turning often until browned and cooked through. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter on the hotplate until soft and golden. Fold each sausage into a slice of white bread with onions and tomato sauce.

w.note: Wobbly vanilla custard between crisp pastry, passionfruit icing.
w.how: Bake 2 sheets of puff pastry (pricked, between trays) at 200C for 25 minutes until flat and golden. Whisk 750ml milk, 120g sugar, 60g cornflour, 3 egg yolks and 2 tsp vanilla in a pot over medium heat for 8 minutes until thick, stir in 30g butter and cool for 20 minutes. Spread the custard over one pastry sheet, top with the other and ice with 1 cup icing sugar mixed with the pulp of 2 passionfruit and a little water. Chill 30 minutes and cut into 4 big squares.

d.n: Stopped-watches billy tea with lemon myrtle
d.note: Billy tea with lemon myrtle and a gum leaf, brewed over the coals
d.how: Bring 1.2 litres water to the boil in a billy or saucepan. Throw in 3 tbsp loose black tea, 1 tsp dried lemon myrtle and a clean gum leaf if you have one, then take off the heat for 2 minutes. Swing the billy or tap the side to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs and stir in a spoon of sweetened condensed milk to taste.
